How we work

The equipment is the easy part

Anyone can put a concentrator in a box. What decides whether therapy actually happens is the fitting, the handover and the person who answers the phone at nine on a Sunday night.

We deliver to the room, assemble in place, verify oxygen purity and therapy pressure on site, fit the mask until the seal is right, and show whoever will be operating the equipment how to use it before we leave.

Oxygen safety in the home

Every cylinder and concentrator we deliver is handed over with a written safety brief for the household. We check the room, position the equipment away from heat sources, and walk the family through storage, cylinder handling and what to do if the power fails. No smoking or open flame within 3 metres. Cylinders stay secured upright, never laid loose.

Sleep & non-invasive ventilation

CPAP & BiPAP machines

Positive airway pressure therapy for obstructive sleep apnea, COPD and chronic hypoventilation. We carry ResMed, BMC and Home Medix devices, and we hold the filters, chambers and tubing for all of them.

CPAP

One steady pressure holds the upper airway open through the night. Auto models sense flow limitation and snore, then adjust within a prescribed window instead of running high all night. Range 4 to 20 cmH₂O, with integrated heated humidification.

BiPAP

Two separate pressures: higher on inspiration, lower on expiration. Easier to exhale against, and able to provide ventilatory support for patients who cannot tolerate CPAP. IPAP to 25 or 30 cmH₂O with adjustable backup rate.

Suction machine

MS-SU-40 · Twin jar

Twin-jar electric aspirator for secretion and fluid removal. Overflow protection isolates the pump, and the vacuum regulator holds its setting under load.

  • Vacuum 0.02 – 0.08 MPa, adjustable
  • Flow rate ≥ 20 L/min free air
  • Jars 2 × 1000 mL autoclavable with overflow float
  • Models trolley-mounted or portable bench unit
Enquire about this device

Medication only works where it lands

Droplets above about 5 microns are swallowed rather than inhaled; below roughly 1 micron they are breathed straight back out. The useful window is narrow, which is why a compressor that has drifted out of specification wastes most of the dose without anyone noticing. We check nebulization rate against specification at every service visit.

Commercial terms

Rent or buy

Every product in this catalogue is available both ways. Which one is right depends almost entirely on how long the equipment will be needed, and that is usually knowable at the point of discharge.

Two ways to get the same equipment

Both options, side by side

Rent

When the need has an end date

Post-operative recovery, a fracture, a chest infection, or a hospital discharge where nobody yet knows how long care will be needed. Rental costs a fraction of purchase and ends when the need does.

  • Monthly terms on cots, wheelchairs, mattresses, concentrators, CPAP and BiPAP
  • Delivery, installation and collection included
  • Servicing included for the whole rental period
  • Deposit adjusted against purchase if the need becomes permanent
  • Extendable month to month, with no fresh delivery charge
Buy

When therapy is for the long term

Sleep apnea, COPD, and any prescription expected to run for years. Beyond roughly eight to twelve months of continuous use, ownership is normally the cheaper route, and the machine is configured to one patient.

  • Manufacturer warranty registered in the patient's name
  • Installation and training included
  • AMC and CMC contracts available from year two
  • Consumables supplied on a replacement schedule
  • GST invoice for insurance and institutional claims

Consumables & after-sales

Services, service contracts & support

Replacement intervals for every consumable in the range, and the service terms that apply to every product we supply. Delivery, installation and maintenance are handled by our own biomedical engineers, not subcontracted.

Rental, service & support

What we do, from order to after-sales

Service 01

Rental & delivery

Monthly rental on cots, wheelchairs, concentrators, CPAP and BiPAP units. Delivered, installed and collected, with servicing included for the rental period.

Service 02

Installation

Siting and commissioning at ward or home. Oxygen purity, flow accuracy, vacuum and therapy pressure verified on site before handover.

Service 03

Maintenance & AMC

Scheduled visits covering filter changes, purity checks with an analyzer, pressure verification and a documented service history per unit.

Service 04

Technical support

Helpline triage, on-site breakdown response against agreed turnaround targets, genuine spares, and standby units on critical equipment.

Service contracts

AMC or CMC

An AMC covers visits and labour. A CMC adds parts and consumables, which is what wards and multi-unit sites normally need.

A reading is only useful if someone knows what to do with it

When we hand over an oximeter we write down the values that should prompt a call, and to whom. Families are far more likely to act early when the threshold is on paper beside the machine rather than remembered from a conversation.

Who we are

About Med Spok Solutions

Med Spok Solutions Pvt Ltd supplies, installs and maintains medical equipment for hospitals, nursing homes, clinics and patients at home, from our premises in Porur, Chennai.

What we do

Supply, installation and service under one roof

We supply CPAP and BiPAP machines and masks, oxygen concentrators and cylinders, suction machines, patient monitors, wheelchairs, hospital cots and physiotherapy supports.

Everything here is available on rent or on sale. Rental suits short-term needs such as post-operative recovery. Purchase suits long-term therapy. We advise on which fits the case, including when that means a smaller order for us.

We stock devices and masks from Home Medix, BMC, ResMed and SVASTEK as an authorized dealer, covering consultation, site assessment, installation, training, preventive maintenance, calibration and spare parts. Sourcing and biomedical engineering are handled in-house.

Our mission

Dependable equipment, wherever the patient is

To make dependable medical equipment available across hospitals and homes, supported by a service team that responds quickly.

Our vision

The supplier people rely on

To be the supplier that hospitals, physicians and families rely on, known for accurate advice, clear pricing and dependable service.

What to send

The faster route to an accurate price

For oxygen

The prescribed flow in litres per minute and how many hours a day it is needed. That decides 5 LPM versus 10 LPM, and concentrator versus cylinder.

For CPAP or BiPAP

The sleep study report or the prescribed pressure range, plus whether the patient breathes through the mouth. That decides the device and the mask type.

For home setup

The discharge summary, the room the patient will be in, and the date they come home. We check doorway widths and turning space before recommending a cot or chair.

Med Spok Solutions Pvt Ltd supplies, installs and maintains medical equipment for hospitals, nursing homes, clinics and patients at home across Chennai. Everything we stock is available on monthly rental or outright purchase.
